description: `--out` and `--out --pretty` of the same document: plain is insertion order with no indent, --pretty is alphabetically sorted keys with 2-space indent; both ensure_ascii-escaped (electricity/docs/spec/runtime-semantics.md §10 C23, DESIGN.md §3.4.1, Q9). The document's input includes a non-ASCII string and a float in exponent form so `ensure_ascii`/float-repr layout are actually exercised, not just key order. Generated as two separate `cof run` invocations of the same document rather than literally one run writing both files (the CLI writes one --out path per invocation) — run id/timestamps differ between the two and are normalized away; every other byte is identical.
